# Getting help

- **A question** (how to do something, why an answer looks the way it does):
  [Discussions, Q&A](https://github.com/imjustprism/borer/discussions/categories/q-a).
- **A bug** (wrong output, a crash, a hang):
  [open an issue](https://github.com/imjustprism/borer/issues/new/choose) with
  the command or tool call, what it answered and the borer version
  (`borer doctor offline`).
- **Something borer should do and does not**: a feature request issue, or an
  idea in [Discussions](https://github.com/imjustprism/borer/discussions/categories/ideas)
  if it is not ready to build yet.
- **A vulnerability**: report it privately, see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

Documentation is at [borer.lol/docs](https://borer.lol/docs). Fixes land on
`main` and ship in the next release; older releases are not patched, so update
first (`borer update`) and check that the problem is still there.

Share a binary only if you are allowed to. For malware, give its SHA-256 and a
public source instead of attaching it.
